headline_item.title_zh: 软银财报巨亏70亿美元，股价却逆势暴涨
headline_item.title_en: SoftBank reports Q2 net loss of $7B vs. a ~$15.8B profit a year ago, on ~$14B revenue vs. ~$12.8B est. as tech selloff weighs on results; shares close up 13.9% (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 软银发布二季度财报显示净亏损70亿美元，但受亚洲科技股回暖及大额投资AI预期支撑，股价反而大涨近14%
headline_item.event_summary_en: SoftBank reported a Q2 net loss of approximately $7 billion, pressured by tech sell-offs. Despite the disappointing results, its stock surged 13.9% due to a Wall Street rebound and optimism surrounding its heavy AI bets, including a $1.85 billion investment in Malaysian AI infrastructure.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】软银集团在第二财季财报发布会：净亏损70亿美元但股价大涨13.9%，并宣布在马来西亚投入18.5亿美元建设AI计算中心
【起因与机理】科技股波动导致账面亏损，但市场对其持续下注OpenAI及基建业务的“AI信仰”给予了更高估值。
【关键数据与实测】软银财报披露二季度净亏损70亿美元。
【观点态度】大规模押注马来西亚AI算力基建以提振市场信心。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] SoftBank Group (Q2 Earnings Release): Reported a $7B net loss while stock surged 13.9%, plus a $1.85B investment in Malaysian AI infrastructure.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Tech market volatility hit the bottom line, but investors are buying the 'AI hype' narrative fueled by their massive OpenAI stakes.
[Key Metrics] SoftBank Q2 net loss hits $7B.
[Perspective & Impact] Significant investment in Malaysian AI infrastructure signals strategic shift.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 只要讲好AI的故事，亏损七十亿美金算什么？软银这就是在告诉投资者：钱不是亏了，而是换成了改变世界的‘入场券’，毕竟赌徒心态一旦被AI包装，韭菜们都能含泪高呼格局大。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: When you lose $7 billion but your stock flies, you aren't a failing investor—you're a 'visionary' betting on the future. As long as the AI narrative is loud enough, investors will happily ignore the red ink in exchange for a seat on the hype train.

headlines.title_zh: 英国政府代码管理疏漏被AI击穿
headlines.title_en: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
headlines.event_summary_zh: 安全研究员利用消费级AI模型，轻易挖掘出英国政府部门在GitHub上泄露敏感凭证及代码漏洞
headlines.event_summary_en: A security researcher utilized consumer-grade AI models on a laptop to expose sensitive credentials and vulnerabilities in GitHub repositories belonging to multiple UK government departments. Due to budget constraints and lack of routine IT maintenance, these agencies inadvertently leaked privileged access keys, creating critical security gaps.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】安全研究员与英国政府多个部门在GitHub公共代码库：通过AI辅助挖掘出被意外上传且权限过大的敏感登录凭证
【起因与机理】政府机构长期IT维护预算不足且缺乏基本的代码安全审计流程
【关键技术规格】研究者利用家用级AI扫描出政府敏感泄露。
【观点态度】系统性的维护资金不足导致基础安全防线崩塌。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Security researcher and UK government departments (Public GitHub repositories): Identified leaked sensitive credentials and deep-level access vulnerabilities using AI
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Systemic budget cuts for IT maintenance and lack of routine security audits
[Key Specification] Researcher exposed sensitive leaks using consumer-grade AI.
[Perspective & Impact] Systemic budget cuts lead to collapsed basic security infrastructure.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这哪是AI威胁论的实战演练，分明是英国政府给全人类演示什么叫‘把核弹钥匙随手扔在路边捡破烂的仓库里’。AI不过是那个帮他们揭开遮羞布的工具，真正的主角是那些连删除过期账号都懒得做的懒政IT团队。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This isn't an AI-apocalypse scenario; it's the UK government showing us exactly how to leave the keys to the kingdom in a public dumpster. AI was just the tool that pointed out their incompetence—real-world IT security is failing because someone forgot that 'open source' doesn't mean 'open your credentials to the world.'

headlines.title_en: GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, raised $19.1M across seed and Series A rounds; FactSet led the Series A (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 金融分析软件开发商GeniosAI完成1910万美元融资，FactSet领投，将加速AI模型在金融场景的落地
headlines.event_summary_en: Financial AI software startup GeniosAI has raised $19.1 million in seed and Series A funding, with financial data giant FactSet leading the Series A. The funding is intended to leverage AI to automate and optimize complex financial modeling and data analysis for institutional clients.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】GeniosAI与FactSet在一级市场投融资领域：FactSet领投GeniosAI 1910万美元融资
【起因与机理】利用AI补强传统金融数据分析的效率短板
【关键数据与实测】融资总额达1910万美元，跨越两轮。
【观点态度】意在通过AI赋能金融模型与分析领域。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] GeniosAI and FactSet (Primary market / Investment): FactSet leads $19.1M investment in GeniosAI
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To leverage AI for enhancing financial data analysis efficiency
[Key Metrics] Raised $19.1M across seed and Series A.
[Perspective & Impact] Focus on AI-driven financial modeling and analysis.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 金融大佬们终于反应过来，与其担心被AI取代，不如直接买下它成为自己的自动化外挂。FactSet这笔钱与其说是投资，不如说是花钱买一张通往金融自动化时代的头等舱船票。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Financial giants finally realized that instead of fearing replacement by AI, it's better to buy it and turn it into a specialized automation add-on. This isn't just an investment; it's FactSet buying a first-class ticket to the inevitable era of AI-driven finance.

celebrity.quote_zh:
一名用户使用 Claude Code 在广州购买的一款杂牌移动电源中发现了隐藏芯片。

每次给 iPhone 充电时，它都会秘密复制整个手机的数据。它还读取 Wi-Fi 密码，连接到家庭网络，并将所有信息发送到远程服务器。

这款充电宝是三周前在机场花19美元买的，标签为30,000mAh，很重，没有品牌。

第一次插上电源时，屏幕提示“信任这台计算机”，用户想都没想就点击了信任，授予其一键读取所有数据的权限。

今天早上，在设置 Claude Code 来监控文件读取后，充电仅 10 秒屏幕就闪烁黄色和红色警告——数据正在传输。

该移动电源被确定为一台内置 64 GB 存储和网络连接的小型计算机。

普通的充电线只使用电源线，但这款充电线既使用电源线又使用数据线，并且已经复制了：

→ 设备信息，1,206 个联系人
→ 所有应用程序，包括 2 个银行应用程序
→ 3,912 张照片，包括护照
→ Wi-Fi 网络名称和密钥
→ 妻子的 iPhone 照片

每次充电时，它都会使用密钥上网并发送新数据 - 3 周内上传 19 次，最后一次上传是在昨晚凌晨 2:14。

用户立即拔掉电源，使用 Claude Code 屏蔽该 IP，并更改 Wi-Fi 密码和银行应用程序登录信息。

维修店将其拆开查看——详情如下。建议：今天检查您家中的每个移动电源。

celebrity.quote_en:
A user discovered a hidden chip in an off-brand power bank purchased in Guangzhou using Claude Code.

Every time it charged an iPhone, it secretly copied the entire phone's data. It also read Wi-Fi passwords, connected to the home network, and sent all the information to a remote server.

This power bank was bought at the airport three weeks ago for $19, labeled as 30,000 mAh, hefty with no brand name.

When first plugged in, the screen prompted "Trust This Computer," and the user clicked trust without thinking, granting it one-click access to read all data.

This morning, after setting up Claude Code to monitor file reads, the screen flashed yellow and red warnings just 10 seconds into charging—data was being transmitted.

The power bank was identified as a mini-computer with built-in 64 GB storage and network connectivity.

Regular charging cables only use power lines, but this one uses both power and data lines, and it has already copied:

→ Device info, 1,206 contacts
→ All apps including 2 banking apps
→ 3,912 photos including passport
→ Wi-Fi network names and keys
→ Wife's iPhone photos

Every charge, it uses the key to go online and send new data—19 uploads over 3 weeks, last one at 2:14 AM last night.

The user immediately unplugged it, used Claude Code to block that IP, and changed the Wi-Fi password and banking app logins.

A repair shop took it apart for a look—details below. Suggestion: Check every power bank in your home today.

titans.name: Superman
titans.event_context_zh:
验证程序检查完全失败。这条新管道迫使特工真正完成工作。

它的工作原理如下：

他们建立了一个具有两个交替阶段的递归循环。

- RSR（递归自重写）：模型根据自己成功重写的轨迹进行自我微调

- RPR（递归策略细化）：然后使用直接从前一阶段继承的“批评家”来运行强化学习（ppo），以锁定那些发现的行为

- 循环：训练序列自行跳跃：Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

而且数字很疯狂..

他们将其应用于 qwen3.8-27b 基础模型。在四个“终端替补”套件中，特工的平均成功率从 20.68% 一路跃升至 50.58%。

在绝对最难的基准测试套件（terminal-bench 4.0）上，基本模型的得分为 0.00%。

在终端 rsi 之后？

它达到了 19.84%（与 Gemini 3.8 flash 等参考型号相当）。

秘密武器？他们确定了奖励制度。

他们不再为人工智能尝试或通过语义检查而给予“密集奖励”，而是转向“成功优先奖励”（spr）。

它在数学上将严格的成功与部分的功劳区分开来。

基本上，只有当代码实际上通过了最终的终端门时，代理才会获得巨额奖励。因此它不再假装成功。

部分本地修复和严格的终端验证之间的差距正在迅速缩小。

我们正在观察代理建立自己的培训环境并自主升级......未来是疯狂的。

titans.quote_en:
A user discovered a hidden chip in an off-brand power bank purchased in Guangzhou using Claude Code.

Every time it charged an iPhone, it secretly copied the entire phone's data. It also read Wi-Fi passwords, connected to the home network, and sent all the information to a remote server.

This power bank was bought at the airport three weeks ago for $19, labeled as 30,000 mAh, hefty with no brand name.

When first plugged in, the screen prompted "Trust This Computer," and the user clicked trust without thinking, granting it one-click access to read all data.

This morning, after setting up Claude Code to monitor file reads, the screen flashed yellow and red warnings just 10 seconds into charging—data was being transmitted.

The power bank was identified as a mini-computer with built-in 64 GB storage and network connectivity.

Regular charging cables only use power lines, but this one uses both power and data lines, and it has already copied:

→ Device info, 1,206 contacts
→ All apps including 2 banking apps
→ 3,912 photos including passport
→ Wi-Fi network names and keys
→ Wife's iPhone photos

Every charge, it uses the key to go online and send new data—19 uploads over 3 weeks, last one at 2:14 AM last night.

The user immediately unplugged it, used Claude Code to block that IP, and changed the Wi-Fi password and banking app logins.

A repair shop took it apart for a look—details below. Suggestion: Check every power bank in your home today.
